compute_l1_loss: compute the L1 loss between predicted and ground truth tensors with optional masking
compute_l2_loss: compute the L2 loss between predicted and ground truth tensors with optional masking
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between a scalar rho and sigmoid-activated rho_hat tensor
compute_ssim: compute the structural similarity index between two image tensors using a Gaussian window
create_gaussian_window: create a 2D Gaussian window kernel for use in SSIM image comparison calculations
